fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E (24x Sep-2027 NTM non-GAAP EPS ~$10.4 = $250, 50%), a 5-year DCF at 12% WACC on a lower FY28 FCF of $1.45B ($197, 30%) and EV/NTM sales of 11x on ~$4.2B ($234, 20%). The result is about $231, roughly 9% above the $210.97 close (down from $244 in round 1 after cutting the net-cash, FCF-conversion and concentration assumptions).

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM non-GAAP EPS at Sep 2027 ~$10.4 (H2 FY28 + H1 FY29; FY28 consensus ~$9.63, FY29 ~$12; ~198M diluted shares incl. up to ~2.8M DustPhotonics earnout shares) x 24x. The multiple is trimmed from 25x because one direct customer is 43% of revenue and 57% of receivables, and Marvell reportedly prices 1.6T AECs 15-20% below Credo.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: FY28 FCF $1.45B (was $1.6B; Q1 FY27 OCF of $90M on $236M non-GAAP NI because the inventory build to $313M continues through the ramp), growing 40/30/22/16/12% over FY29-33, terminal growth 4%, WACC 12% (beta ~3), plus ~$1.8B net cash by Sep-2027 (was $2.3B; $764M today plus ~5 quarters of FCF, less ~$32M earnout cash), over 205M diluted shares.

methods.name: EV/sales
methods.inputs: NTM revenue at Sep 2027 ~$4.2B (FY27 ~$2.5B, FY28 ~$3.7-3.8B, consistent with the $9.63 consensus EPS at ~49% net margin) x 11x EV/sales = $46.2B, plus $1.8B net cash, over 205M shares.

bear.story: The dominant customer (43% direct / 33% end, likely Amazon Trainium) dual-sources 1.6T AECs to Marvell, which is cheaper and ahead on 1.6T retimers, or TE/Broadcom; or hyperscalers digest 2027 capex. The H2 FY27 optical ramp slips, so the ~23% sequential H2 growth needed is missed. FY28 EPS lands at ~$6.5, gross margin falls toward 62-64%, working capital keeps absorbing cash and the multiple compresses to ~18x, near or below the $150 Sep-2026 panic low.

base.story: FY27 revenue of ~$2.5B (+85-90%) and >$600M optical are delivered, and FY28 grows ~50% (the 'outsized growth again' guide). Non-GAAP GM holds at ~67% and FY28 EPS is ~$9.5-10, but cash conversion stays mediocre through the ramp and sector multiples compress (Mizuho-style cuts). The stock trades at ~22-24x NTM EPS.

bull.story: Hyperscaler 2027 capex reaches ~$1.2-1.3T. Amazon Trn3 ramps strongly (Mizuho channel checks) with Credo keeping share at 1.6T, ZeroFlap optics, PICs and optical DSPs scale, ALC/OmniConnect add FY28 revenue and diversification to 3-4 >10% customers improves the quality of revenue. NTM EPS is ~$13.5 at ~27x, and the stock clears the $309 high.

thesis_break_reason: Unchanged at $125. That is ~13x FY28 consensus EPS of $9.63 and ~17% below the verified $150.09 close of 2026-09-14, which was reached in a sentiment-only selloff after a beat-and-raise. Trading there would most likely mean a fundamental break: the 43% direct customer cutting or dual-sourcing (e.g. Marvell 1.6T AECs), a failed H2 FY27 optical ramp or guide-down, or a hyperscaler capex cut, rather than ordinary ~96% volatility.

key_uncertainties: Customer concentration: end customers 33/28/13/10% (top 4 = 84%), and on a direct-billing basis one customer is 43% of revenue and 57% of receivables
1.6T AEC share: Marvell reportedly ahead on 1.6T retimers and 15-20% cheaper, and Amazon holds Credo warrants that effectively rebate its AEC price
Whether the H2 FY27 optical ramp (>$600M optical, ~$1.47B H2 revenue) arrives on time, and its gross-margin mix effect
Cash conversion: Q1 OCF of $90M against $236M non-GAAP NI; persistent working-capital absorption undercuts the DCF and the net-cash rebuild
Durability of hyperscaler AI capex into 2027-28 and the sector multiple regime (peer multiples compressing)
reasoning: Round 2. The supervisor confirmed my core facts (Q1 FY27 $479M, Q2 guide $525-535M, FY27 >85% growth with >$600M optical, ~22x FY28 consensus EPS of $9.63, a $150.09 closing low on 9/14, FY28 revenue +50-55% as consensus-consistent). It corrected my net-cash assumption and sharpened concentration and competition risk. I verified in the Q1 10-Q summary: cash plus short-term investments of $764M after the $770M DustPhotonics cash outlay, Q1 OCF $90.2M and FCF ~$83M, inventory up to $313M, and Customer A at 43% of revenue and 57% of AR. The DustPhotonics earnout is mostly shares (up to ~2.8M) plus ~$32M cash. So I cut Sep-2027 net cash from $2.3B to ~$1.8B (slightly below the midpoint of the supervisor's $1.6-2.0B, since I expect conversion to improve as the ramp matures) and FY28 FCF from $1.6B to $1.45B. That takes the DCF from $219 to $197. I trimmed the P/E multiple from 25x to 24x for the worse direct concentration and Marvell's pricing at 1.6T ($262 to $250), and EV/sales moves from $237 to $234 on lower cash. Blended fair value falls from $244 to $231. Consensus target is ~$270 (evidence only). I agree with the supervisor that FY28 growth of ~50% is the right base, which I already had, so there is no upward change there. The distribution is a three-scenario lognormal mixture: bear $120 (33%, sigma 0.45), base $232 (45%, sigma 0.25), bull $370 (22%, sigma 0.32). Compared with round 1, I lowered the base centre and slightly widened both tails. The left tail widens for concentration and competition. The right tail widens because the stock went from $86 to $309 within the past year, so my round-1 P(>=$527) of 0.028 was too thin. The resulting median is ~$220 (was ~$228), P(>=$211) is 0.537 (was 0.565), P(<$127) is ~18.5% and P(>=$422) is 8%. My left tail is somewhat thinner than the supervisor's ~21% below $127 because the thesis-break at $125 already requires a genuine fundamental break, and the Q2 guide beat plus FY28 consensus rising (from $8.62 to $9.63) argue for momentum. Research was about 4 additional searches and fetches this round.
